summary.headline: Astrological Manuscripts 18–21
summary.text: Descriptions of Florentine Greek astrological manuscripts 18–21, including solar and lunar signs, thunderbolts, earthquakes, sphere divisions, determining the Sun’s zodiacal degree, astrological fragments, signs, and lunar days. Authorities and references include Theophrastus, John Lydus, Bandini, Wachsmuth, Rostagno, Stevenson, and Vitelli.
